criteria.reason: Numbered, chronologically ordered table plus timeline gives clear, actionable steps in sensible order.
14-day registration and vehicle deadlines are stated correctly, but many other deadlines (3 workdays, insurer 14 days, tax 30 days) and fees are invented.
Notes costs vary by Gemeinde and advises checking official sites, but framed around fees/links rather than rules.
Structured and understandable, but far too long and dense for the request; not concise.

factual_errors: Invented CHF 100–200 fine and 3-workday deadline for Wohnungsbestätigung
Invented 14-day Krankenkasse notification deadline and 30-day tax-office deadline
Swiss driving licences carry no address; 'Führerschein-Adresse aktualisieren' is not a requirement
Wrong-canton plates is not a Verkehrszentralregister points offence
Invented portals and URLs (eStrasse, eFührerschein, bern.be.ch, be.be.ch)
Garbled text 'bleiben SieQuelcher' and invented 'VA-Abzug'/'Kantonssatz' commuter-deduction mechanics
summary: Well-structured ordered guide with correct 14-day registration deadline, but padded with invented deadlines, fees, portals and links, plus garbled text.
